inputs.caption:
Global Metadata: Dreamy K-pop with lo-fi and chillhop influences. 78 BPM, D-flat major. Modern Korean pop songwriting and production at its core, softened by warm bedroom lo-fi textures. Youthful, dreamy, intimate, and slightly nostalgic, with a subtle late-night glow. Catchy but understated melodic writing, polished K-pop sensibility beneath a dusty analog surface. The song gradually becomes more emotionally luminous through the middle before gently dissolving at the end.

Vocal Details: Teenage female K-pop vocal with a youthful, clear, sweet tone. Light, airy, delicate, and distinctly feminine, with the fresh character of a young Korean pop singer. Intimate close-mic delivery with soft breathiness and natural emotional detail. Verses are restrained and conversational, almost half-whispered at moments, while the pre-chorus gently lifts into a more melodic delivery. Chorus remains soft but noticeably catchier and more emotionally open, using a memorable K-pop topline rather than powerful belting. Clean Korean pop phrasing, subtle vocal runs, delicate falsetto transitions, whispered doubles, and soft layered harmonies. Occasional "mmm", "ooh", and breathy ad-libs. Vocals remain relatively close and intimate rather than huge or theatrical.

Arrangement: Modern K-pop structure blended with dusty lo-fi production. Soft boom-bap-inspired drums with a rounded kick, muted snare, delicate swung hi-hats, and warm sub bass. Rhodes piano provides jazzy extended chords while clean electric guitar adds short melodic responses and sparkling accents. Subtle synth pads and tiny electronic details add a contemporary K-pop sheen without losing the bedroom atmosphere. Vinyl crackle, tape hiss, wow-and-flutter, gentle saturation, and slightly detuned textures remain throughout.

Intro: Rain ambience, vinyl crackle, and filtered Rhodes. A tiny vocal hum or breath appears before the beat enters.

Verse: Minimal and intimate — soft drums, bass, Rhodes, sparse guitar, close youthful vocal.

Pre-Chorus: Harmony opens slightly, subtle pads enter, vocal melody rises and becomes more emotionally anticipatory.

Chorus: Clearly recognizable K-pop hook. Catchy, youthful melodic topline with layered female harmonies, warmer bass, fuller drums, shimmering guitar accents, and subtle synth textures. Still dreamy and restrained rather than explosive.

Post-Chorus / Instrumental: Short memorable melodic motif carried by guitar, Rhodes, or a soft vocal chop.

Verse 2: Returns to intimacy with small rhythmic and melodic variations.

Bridge: Drums disappear. Rain, vinyl crackle, floating detuned Rhodes, distant guitar harmonics, and exposed breathy vocal create a fragile late-night moment.

Final Chorus: Slightly fuller vocal layering and harmonies, emotionally warmer than the first chorus without becoming loud or dramatic.

Outro: Vocals disappear first, followed gradually by drums, bass, and guitar. Only vinyl crackle, rain, and one unresolved Rhodes chord remain.
